warp_points: warp image keypoints with a 3x3 homography matrix to transform coordinates between images
filter_points: filter image keypoints to keep only those within specified image boundary dimensions
keep_true_points: keep keypoints that remain within image bounds after warping by a homography matrix
select_k_best_points: select the k most probable keypoints from a tensor sorted by probability score
load_image: load and resize an image from file path into a normalized tensor for SuperPoint model input
